faqs.question: How does this comply with Income Tax Rule 46?
faqs.answer: Rule 46 requires books of account and related records to be retained for at least 7 years in immutable format. Our WORM compliance vault enforces cryptographic retention locks that prevent modification or deletion for the statutory period.

faqs.question: Where is the data stored?
faqs.answer: Data is stored strictly in sovereign Tier-IV Indian data centers meeting all data localization and DPDP Act requirements.

faqs.title: How does immutable backup stop ransomware?
faqs.body: Immutable backups use strict WORM (Write-Once-Read-Many) policies. Once a restore point is written, no user, script, or ransomware process can modify, delete, or overwrite the data until the designated retention period expires.
